emma: Thanks for the all-hands questions on runway/budget. Threading finance & procurement follow-ups here. Short replies pls.
rachel: Quick ask  whats the revised runway number w/ current commitments?
emma: Base-case runway ~15 months. Downside (no ARR growth) ~11 months. Upside (conservative growth) ~19 months.
tom: If we need to tighten spend, which hiring buckets are first to pause? eng/product/research?
emma: Priority pause: non-customer-facing research + new infra experiments. Exempt: oncall eng, Dedicated SRE, security. We'll publish a formal exempt list by Thu.
ben: Procurement note: new intake + approvals will be live Tue. Quick thresholds: <= $25k manager+proc; $25-100k add finance; >$100k add legal+exec.
li: Legal: DPAs required for any vendor touching customer data. For emergency buys, route "EMERGENCY" subject and follow up with paperwork within 72h.
finance-bot: Workbook uploaded: /docs/finance/runway-variants-2026.xlsx (base/downside/upside).
emma: Action items: eng leads submit critical hires by EOD Fri; procurement post intake form Tue; finance share burn cadence schedule Mon. I'll schedule a follow-up cross-team sync after artifacts are posted.
